items.text: Arizona QB: Gardner Minshew injured (IR); rookie Carson Beck makes his second straight start. The schedule still lists Minshew.

Arizona (Wed): DNP - DL Walter Nolen III (illness); S Budda Baker, G Isaac Seumalo, OLB Josh Sweat, LB Mack Wilson rest days. LIMITED - C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion protocol), G Jon Gaines II (ankle), LT Jayden Williams (knee), CB Max Melton. IR - S Andrew Wingard, LB Jordan Burch, RB James Conner, RB Jeremiyah Love, WR Michael Wilson, OT Paris Johnson II.

Kansas City (Wed/Thu): DNP both days - RB Kenneth Walker III (groin, expected to miss a 2nd game; Emmett Johnson starts), G Trey Smith (concussion), OT Jaylon Moore (ankle). LIMITED - DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee). LB Nick Bolton upgraded to full. Patrick Mahomes full, starts.
